item_1_weekend_gap_moderate_arm_FIRST.title: STANDING FIRST TASK (weekend gaps): the weather owner gets a MODERATE arm between priced and fresh, keyed to the measurable weekend-cycle delta sum - fixes BOTH G13 gap misses with one rule
item_1_weekend_gap_moderate_arm_FIRST.action: AMEND magnitude.block_gap_ownership branch (2) WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER: three arms instead of two.
item_1_weekend_gap_moderate_arm_FIRST.rule: Define NEAR-SUM = the sum of same-sign delta_vs_prior_by_horizon over D0..D+4 in the newest available weekend cycle batch, plus the D-1-evening forecast_run_delta when same-signed. Arms: |NEAR-SUM| < ~1 -> PRICED band 200..400; |NEAR-SUM| ~1..3 (and no new-shot birth) -> MODERATE band 600..1500 at the delta sign; |NEAR-SUM| > ~3 OR a new-shot first appearance at any horizon -> FRESH band 1500..2500. Direction is symmetric: warm CUTS are weather information exactly as cold ADDS are - the G13 0215 miss was a weather check that only looked for fresh cold and let a -2.26 cut sum default to the chain-drift stub.
item_1_weekend_gap_moderate_arm_FIRST.mechanism: The gap prices the weekend model information; the information's size is the delta mass the cycle delivered at tradeable horizons. A sub-1 wobble is priced noise; a 1-3 gw-HDD same-sign mass is a real but non-shock repricing; a >3 mass or a new shot is a regime event. No free constants: the bands are the walk's three existing gap classes, the assignment key is computed from the feed.

item_4_q1_0223_where_the_crash_ran.question: (i) 0223 -1770, the blind's highest-conviction up day: where inside the day did the crash run, and fade vs ratify state
item_4_q1_0223_where_the_crash_ran.curve_answer: It ran EVERYWHERE except the catch-up window: evening -260 by 22:00, overnight -690 by 06:00; the 06-10 catch-up window BOUNCED (-690 -> -450 at 08:00) - the desks tested the delivery bid - then broke to -990 by 10:00; midday -1110; the AFTERNOON was the largest phase (-1650 by 14:00, close -1770). So: NOT a catch-up-window fade - the fade began at the 0222 Sunday session itself (-160 on the gap day), the catch-up window was the day's only counter-phase, and the chain owned the close (close_ownership form, 0202/1117 pattern).
item_4_q1_0223_where_the_crash_ran.fade_vs_ratify_state: The ratify Mondays (1020, 1208, 0202) all had their DRIVER AHEAD of them (fresh-turn birth, flip-confirm, structural unwind). 0223's driver was BEHIND: D0=27.6 was the peak ITSELF realizing, the entire forward stream sat below normal from D+2 (-0.7/-1.4/-2.2), the morning cycles cut D+2, and the 0219 print had flipped the storage backdrop (+15.8 above). Gap-at-extreme WITH a 5-session swing + catalyst crest = the FADE configuration (1109->1110 form) compounded by lull onset. SELL THE REALIZATION: a priced shot's peak day is a crest, not a confirmation.
item_4_q1_0223_where_the_crash_ran.brain_action: ADD to timing.catalyst_continuity_frontrun a MIRROR ARM (catalyst crest): the frontrun logic runs WITH a building catalyst and INVERTS when D0 carries the catalyst's maximum and the forward stream is same-sign cutting - continuation stops pricing; the day classes as give-back/lull. (b) HONESTY: the walk's evidence to date is winter-only - the brain's weather-heavy rule set is winter-calibrated BY CIRCUMSTANCE and should be EXPECTED to age as the walk exits winter (G14+ into March/April = the spring shoulder + maintenance season + the injection-season turn). A rule fading in the shoulder is the slider working, not the rule failing - but that judgment requires this slider to be stated. (c) TIE-INS: the G6 lesson (HDD beats surplus at the autumn->winter transition) is the slider's first recorded instance; regime_scope already names warm-season vs winter thinness; the day-class layer is ORTHOGONAL (class first, then seasonal salience inside the class); magnitude bands stay regime/condition-scoped exactly as they are. (d) FORWARD CONSEQUENCE: G14 opens the walk's first shoulder-season blocks - the slider's first forward test; at each block open the agent reads the seasonal position explicitly (calendar + storage phase + HDD/CDD levels) and records which family it weights and why, per-event.
